hyperedges.description: Apple apps architecture: reuse Firebase SDK for auth/data, call existing API routes for TMDB/discover/recommendations, inherit token system from redesign
Development discipline: issue-tracked work → commits reference issues → code follows architecture rules (TMDB proxy, Firestore database, etc)
Phase 2 roadmap sequence: preferred services foundation → watchlist alerts consume services/countries → AI recommendations seed from watchlist → UI redesign unifies all with token system
Recommendation generation: candidates from TMDB → Claude structured output selects/explains → validation against candidates → results cached → grounded by construction
TMDB access process: client requests → proxy routes → server-side calls → CDN caching. Key never exposed; migration complete
User auth and preferences flow: Google sign-in via Firebase Auth → AuthContext subscribes to state → Firestore stores in named database watchatlaspreference
Watchlist alerts pipeline: user saves title → stored in Firestore subcollection → daily cron diffs snapshots → events appended → notifications fan out on transitions

nodes.label: Architecture Rule: Tailwind + CSS Variables
nodes.description: Styling: Tailwind v4 + CSS-variable system in styles/globals.css (dark default, .light overrides). Follow existing variables rather than hardcoding colors

nodes.label: CSS Variable Design System
nodes.description: Hand-rolled design system in styles/globals.css using CSS variables for colors, spacing, borders. Dark is default; .light class overrides. Uses Tailwind v4 + NextUI. No hardcoded colors allowed (CLAUDE.md rule)

nodes.label: Dual Theme Systems (Drift)
nodes.description: Two competing implementations: next-themes (localStorage 'theme', .dark/.light) and custom toggle (localStorage 'darkMode', .light class on :root). Custom one drives UI; they can disagree

nodes.label: AppLayout Component
nodes.description: Live shell for the web app; header/footer/theme toggle. NavBar.tsx is dead code. AppLayout handles navigation (Home / Discover / Watchlist / Settings in Phase 2)

nodes.label: Web Pages & Routes
nodes.description: Pages: index.tsx (home), details/[id].tsx (title detail), settings.tsx (preferences), /watchlist (badges), /discover (recommendations). API routes: /api/tmdb/* (8 proxy routes), /api/health, /api/cron/health-check, /api/cron/availability-diff (Phase 3)

nodes.label: Country-Centric Where to Watch
nodes.description: Core differentiator: detail pages group TMDB watch-provider data by country and continent, filterable by user's favorite countries. Shows global availability comparison versus single-country views

nodes.label: Country & Continent Data
nodes.description: countries.ts, countryContinents.ts (dead code, not imported), getDisplayCountries.ts, and full_country_list_with_flags.json (~250 countries). Settings and details pages use continent from JSON instead of countryContinents.ts (disagreement for 216 of 249 countries noted)

nodes.label: Thin Test Coverage (Known Drift)
nodes.description: First tests landed 2026-07-19 (19 tests over helpers). Components, pages, API routes remain uncovered. Playwright E2E setup referenced in git history is absent

nodes.label: Missing Placeholder Image
nodes.description: getPosterUrl() falls back to /placeholder.png which doesn't exist in public/. Every posterless title renders a broken image

nodes.label: TMDB Key Migration (d0b6451)
nodes.description: Completed 2026-07-02: no code reads NEXT_PUBLIC_TMDB_API_KEY anymore; server-only TMDB_API_KEY via /api/tmdb/* routes. History still contains old values; those keys must be rotated at TMDB, Firebase, Google Cloud

nodes.label: Architecture Rule: TMDB Proxy Only
nodes.description: TMDB access only via internal proxy routes pages/api/tmdb/*. Never call TMDB from client or expose key. Server-only TMDB_API_KEY is the target. Don't add uses of NEXT_PUBLIC_TMDB_API_KEY

nodes.label: Commit & PR Convention
nodes.description: Every change maps to a GitHub issue. Commits/PRs reference issue (Fixes #12) so it auto-links and auto-closes. No uncaptured work

nodes.label: GitHub Issue Hierarchy (Feature → Story → Task)
nodes.description: Work tracked on WatchAtlas GitHub Project v2 board. Feature → Story → Task hierarchy via native sub-issues. Exactly one type: label per issue. Status: Backlog → Ready → In progress → In review → Done. Tasks created during coding sessions (lazy)

nodes.label: Firebase for Auth and Preferences
nodes.description: Google sign-in via Firebase Auth + Firestore for user preferences. Named database watchatlaspreference selected deliberately, separate from default database. Minimal-friction single-provider auth

nodes.label: Pivot from Expo to Next.js Web
nodes.description: Rebuilt WatchAtlas as a web app on Next.js 14 instead of continuing as an Expo/React Native mobile app (a .expo/ remnant remains). Reason: faster iteration, single deploy target on Vercel, no app-store friction
nodes.source_location: Inferred decision: Pivot from Expo/React Native to Next.js web
nodes.norm_label: pivot from expo to next.js web

nodes.label: Proxy All TMDB Calls Through API Routes
nodes.description: All TMDB requests from browser go through internal /api/tmdb/* proxy routes on the server. Hides API key, centralizes error handling, enables Vercel CDN caching
nodes.source_location: Inferred decision: Proxy all TMDB calls
nodes.norm_label: proxy all tmdb calls through api routes

nodes.label: Remove AI Recommendations (Gemini)
nodes.description: Removed Gemini-powered recommendations after iteration. Replaced with grounded Claude-based recommender that selects only from real TMDB candidates (Phase 2)

nodes.label: Typography
nodes.description: 'Showtime' logo font and 'Cinzel' via Google Fonts. WCAG 2.1 AA contrast required in both light and dark themes

nodes.label: Undefined Continent Headings
nodes.description: 42 of 249 countries in full_country_list_with_flags.json carry continent: 'Undefined', which settings.tsx renders verbatim as section heading

nodes.label: User Preferences Logic (lib/preferences.ts)
nodes.description: Firebase-free preference logic that normalizes and hardens Firestore data before the app sees it. Used by auth context and tests

nodes.label: Cron State Persistence Issue (R-6)
nodes.description: Health-check cron keeps debounce state in module-level variables, which serverless does not reliably persist. Alerts may misbehave in production. Should move state to Firestore

nodes.label: Architecture Rule: AppLayout is Live Shell
nodes.description: components/NavBar.tsx is dead code — don't extend it. AppLayout.tsx is the live shell
nodes.norm_label: architecture rule: applayout is live shell

nodes.label: Uptime Monitoring with Multi-Channel Alerting
nodes.description: /api/health TMDB probe + StatusBanner polling + daily Vercel cron at /api/cron/health-check with CRON_SECRET protection, fans out alerts to Discord/Slack/email on status transitions with 2-failure debounce

nodes.label: Notifications (lib/notifications.ts)
nodes.description: Discord + Slack webhook + Resend email fan-out on TMDB status transitions. Called by /api/cron/health-check when status changes

nodes.label: StatusBanner Component
nodes.description: Polls /api/health every 60s to show TMDB status to users. Renders health status at top of page

nodes.label: ShowCard Component
nodes.description: Poster card component reused across home rows, watchlist grid, and discover page for displaying movie/TV titles

nodes.label: Discover Merge Logic (lib/discoverMerge.ts)
nodes.description: parseProviderIds, mergeDiscoverResults, splitProvidersByPreference — pure functions for merging cross-region TMDB discover results, deduping by (media_type, id), sorting by popularity, and grouping providers by user preference

nodes.label: Provider Catalog Helpers (lib/providerCatalog.ts)
nodes.description: parseRegions, mergeProviderCatalog — pure functions with zero imports for combining movie+TV provider catalogs, deduping by provider ID, and sorting by TMDB priority

nodes.label: Preferred Services Design Spec
nodes.description: Approved specification for service selection UI: Settings tabs by country, global flat set, catalog route, discover route, home row, two-tier detail-page grouping, pure logic + tests

nodes.label: Watchlist + Availability Alerts Design Spec
nodes.description: Approved specification: Firestore subcollection storage, snapshot-diff pipeline (global per title), firebase-admin, daily cron, /watchlist badged grid, event filtering by country/service, 7-day window

nodes.label: AI Recommendation Engine Design Spec
nodes.description: Approved specification: grounded candidates from TMDB (watchlist-similar, on-services, trending), Claude structured-output selection/explanation, caching with signature, mood steering, cost control ($0.04/gen on Opus 4.8)

nodes.label: Node Test Runner
nodes.description: Built-in Node.js test runner via tsx. npm test runs tests/**/*.test.ts. First tests landed 2026-07-19 for pure helpers: getDisplayCountries, countries data, getPosterUrl

nodes.label: AI Recommendation Engine (FR-14 to FR-20)
nodes.description: Claude-powered grounded recommender on /discover page. Builds ~50 TMDB candidates from watchlist-similar, on-your-services, and trending. Claude selects and explains from candidates only (never generates). Cached 24h, max 20 generations/day

nodes.label: Firestore Integration (lib/firestore.ts)
nodes.description: Exports types (UserPreferences, FavoriteService, etc) and functions (normalizePreferences, etc). Uses named database 'watchatlaspreference'

nodes.label: Architecture Rule: Named Firestore Database
nodes.description: Firestore is a named database: getFirestore(app, 'watchatlaspreference'). Keep using it; default database is empty and must stay unused

nodes.label: Auth & User Preferences
nodes.description: Google Identity Services sign-in via Firebase Auth. User preferences stored in Firestore named database 'watchatlaspreference' at users/{uid} including favoriteCountries, favoriteServices, and darkMode

nodes.label: Claude API (claude-opus-4-8)
nodes.description: Model used for recommendation engine (Phase 2). Structured outputs for schema-validated JSON. Cost ~$0.04/gen. Haiku 4.5 (~$0.008) is documented cost lever. @anthropic-ai/sdk dependency
nodes.source_location: Section 6 Tech Stack & Platform, Section 5.3 AI recommendations

nodes.label: Firestore Data Structure
nodes.description: Named database 'watchatlaspreference'. Collections: users/{uid} (preferences), users/{uid}/watchlist/{mediaType_tmdbId} (Phase 2), users/{uid}/recommendations/current (Phase 2), availabilitySnapshots/{mediaType_tmdbId} (Phase 2), availabilityEvents (Phase 2, append-only)

nodes.label: Preferred Streaming Services (FR-1 to FR-6)
nodes.description: Phase 2 feature: users select and save favorite streaming services (TMDB provider IDs). Powers personalized 'On My Services' home row, and reorders providers on detail pages (preferred first, then others)

nodes.label: Apple Platform Apps Program Overview
nodes.description: Program decomposition: 5a (requirements + API contract), 5b (iOS/iPadOS), 5c (tvOS), 5d (macOS), 5e (release operations). SwiftUI multiplatform stack, hybrid backend architecture (native Firebase SDK + existing API routes)

nodes.label: AuthContext (lib/AuthContext.tsx)
nodes.description: React Context for auth state. Subscribes to onAuthStateChanged, exposes user, preferences, signOut, updatePreferences, refreshPreferences. Contains verbose debug logging (PII issue noted)

nodes.label: Cross-Platform UI Redesign (FR-21 to FR-27)
nodes.description: Rebuild all surfaces against token system (color, type, spacing, radius, elevation) defined platform-neutrally for both CSS and SwiftUI. Account for tvOS 10-foot constraints and platform navigation idioms from the start

nodes.label: Roadmap: Phase 2 + Phase 3
nodes.description: Ship in two releases: Phase 2 (v2.0) = preferred services, watchlist alerts, AI recommendations, UI redesign (web + app requirements). Phase 3 (v3.0) = Apple platform builds (iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, macOS)
nodes.source_location: Decision: Ship roadmap as Phase 2 and Phase 3

nodes.label: Apple Platform Apps - Phase 3 (FR-28 to FR-32)
nodes.description: SwiftUI multiplatform apps for iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, macOS. Share Swift packages (models, API client, Firebase layer). Use native Firebase SDK for auth/data, existing Next.js API routes for TMDB/discover/recommendations. Never embed TMDB key
nodes.norm_label: apple platform apps - phase 3 (fr-28 to fr-32)

nodes.label: Watchlist with Availability Alerts (FR-7 to FR-13, FR-37)
nodes.description: Users save titles to watchlist. Daily snapshot-diff cron detects when titles arrive on or leave user's preferred services/countries. Badged grid on /watchlist shows changes within 7-day window, plus coming-soon banners for unreleased titles
nodes.norm_label: watchlist with availability alerts (fr-7 to fr-13, fr-37)

nodes.label: Architecture Rule: Cache Control Headers
nodes.description: API routes must set Cache-Control: s-maxage headers. Preserve or consciously adjust when touching routes

nodes.label: Environment Variables & Secrets
nodes.description: Server-only: TMDB_API_KEY, CRON_SECRET, FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY (Phase 2). Client: NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_*, NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID. Optional alert channels: DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL, SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL, RESEND_API_KEY, NOTIFICATION_EMAIL_TO

nodes.label: WatchAtlas
nodes.description: A global streaming availability guide that shows where movies and TV shows can be streamed, rented, or bought across every country, grouped by continent

nodes.label: Vercel CDN Caching
nodes.description: API routes set Cache-Control: s-maxage headers per route. Search 300s, trending/popular/lists 600s, details/providers 3600s. Stale-while-revalidate enabled

nodes.label: WatchAtlas Logo
nodes.description: Circular badge with silver/gray border on black background. Center features a globe (blue and green) with white and teal compass/navigation markers, combined with stylized play button and magnifying glass. Text 'WATCHATLAS' and 'GLOBAL STREAMING GUIDE' below

nodes.label: TMDB Data Flow
nodes.description: Client never calls TMDB directly; all requests go through internal /api/tmdb/* proxy routes to the server, which calls api.themoviedb.org/3 server-side with TMDB_API_KEY. CDN caches responses with per-route Cache-Control headers

nodes.label: WatchAtlas Banner Image
nodes.description: Dark blue background with WatchAtlas logo (globe with play button) on left, white text 'WatchAtlas' with gradient accent, tagline 'Your atlas for what to watch next.', and 'AN AURORA PEAK PRODUCT' attribution

nodes.label: Vercel Deployment
nodes.description: Deployed on Vercel. Every push to main ships to production; other branches get preview deployments. vercel.json schedules daily health-check cron at 09:00 UTC

nodes.label: Tech Stack
nodes.description: Next.js 14 Pages Router, React 18, TypeScript 5, Firebase Auth + Firestore, TMDB v3 API (proxied), Vercel hosting, Tailwind CSS v4, NextUI components

nodes.label: Aurora Peak
nodes.description: Organization/author of WatchAtlas. GitHub org: aurora-peak. Project board at github.com/orgs/aurora-peak/projects/2
nodes.source_location: About section and Project Board section

nodes.label: TMDB Client Library (lib/tmdb.ts)
nodes.description: Pure fetch wrappers (tmdbService) that call internal /api/tmdb/* proxy routes. Never calls TMDB directly from client

nodes.label: TMDB Logo
nodes.description: TMDB text in large green and teal letters, with stylized rounded shape on the right in cyan blue. Attribution logo for The Movie Database partnership
